name: CustomLayout
description: Represents a custom layout associated with a presentation design. The CustomLayout object is a member of the CustomLayouts collection.
remarks: Use the CustomLayout property of the Slide or SlideRange objects to access a CustomLayout object, for example: Use the Add method of the CustomLayouts collection to add a new custom layout to the presentation design's custom layouts. Use the Item method to refer to a custom layout. Use the Paste method to paste the slides on the Clipboard into a custom layout and add the custom layout to the CustomLayouts collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns a reference to the slide master object that is the parent of the specified CustomLayout object. Read-only.

properties.name: Shapes
properties.description: Returns a Shapes collection representing all the layout elements included in the specified custom layout. Read-only.

properties.name: HeadersFooters
properties.description: Returns a HeadersFooters collection that represents the header, footer, date and time, and slide number associated with the specified custom layout.

properties.name: Background
properties.description: Returns a ShapeRange object that represents the slide background. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Represents the display name of the specified custom layout. Read/write.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns the height of the specified object, in points. Read-only.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns the width of the specified custom layout, in points. Read-only.

properties.name: Hyperlinks
properties.description: Returns a Hyperlinks collection that represents all hyperlinks on the slide associated with the specified custom layout. Read-only.

properties.name: Design
properties.description: Returns a Design object that represents the design template associated with the specified custom layout.

properties.name: TimeLine
properties.description: Returns a TimeLine object that represents the animation timeline for the slide associated with the specified custom layout. Read-only.

properties.name: SlideShowTransition
properties.description: Returns a SlideShowTransition object that represents the special effects for the specified custom layout. Read-only.

properties.name: MatchingName
properties.description: Represents the internal name of the specified custom layout. Read/write.

properties.name: Preserved
properties.description: Determines whether the specified custom layout is preserved from changes. Read/write.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns the index position of the specified custom layout in the CustomLayouts collection. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayMasterShapes
properties.description: Determines whether the specified custom layout displays background objects on the slide master. Read/write.

properties.name: FollowMasterBackground
properties.description: Determines whether the specified custom layout follows the slide master background. Read/write.

properties.name: ThemeColorScheme
properties.description: Returns a ThemeColorScheme object that represents the color scheme of the theme associated with the specified custom layout. Read-only.

properties.name: CustomerData
properties.description: Returns a CustomerData object.

properties.name: Guides
properties.description: Returns the Guides collection associated with a custom layout. Read-only.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Deletes the specified object and places it on the Clipboard.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the specified object to the Clipboard.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the specified custom layout, adds the new custom layout to the CustomLayouts collection immediately after the original custom layout, and returns a CustomLayout object that represents the duplicate layout.

methods.name: MoveTo
methods.description: Moves the specified CustomLayout object to a different position in the CustomLayouts collection.

parameters.name: toPos
parameters.description: The index position in the CustomLayouts collection to which the CustomLayout object will be moved.
